surveyed.source: Backlog destination point (OSM memorial) in the Sarphatipark; monument axes, pool outline and facing read from Commons photographs, the facing is a visual estimate, not a surveyed bearing

attribution.title: Sarphatimonument - reconstruction from photographs
attribution.author: Map Recall; sculpture by J.Th. Stracké (bust); J. Gosschalk (monument) (1886); figure reconstructed from photographs by Huegette D. Eldering, Alf van Beem, Wikifrits
attribution.modifications: Figure reconstructed (TripoSR single-view) from Wikimedia Commons photographs: "Sarpahti monument.jpg" by Huegette D. Eldering (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sarpahti_monument.jpg); "Sarphatipark pic5.JPG" by Alf van Beem (Public domain, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sarphatipark_pic5.JPG); "Amsterdam monument samuel sarphati.jpg" by Wikifrits (CC0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Amsterdam_monument_samuel_sarphati.jpg). Decimated to about 6,000 triangles per figure in the kit's material, no photo colour; plinth, pier and setting are the original low-poly kit model.
